name: Webform IP Delete
description: helps delete IP addresses collected in webform submissions.
project_description:
This module helps delete IP addresses collected by the Webform module.

 While Webform allows site administrators to disable collection of IP addresses, the setting can be easy to overlook. There is no simple way for site builders to delete existing IP addresses from Webform Submissions.

 Additional Requirements 
 This module requires the Webform module.

 Post-Installation 
 To use this action plugin you need to activate "Delete collected IP addresses" action at /admin/structure/webform/config/#edit-bulk-form-settings . Then this action plugin will be available at the bulk operations

dropdown at /admin/structure/webforms .

 Features 
 The module adds an action plugin to remove collected IP addresses for each webform.
